finding: An MDD with an odd number of semantic coordinates has a padded upper bit. The first permutation implementation omitted its identity mapping. The exhaustive two-state XYZ relation check caught an index overrun before any benchmark ran.
resolution: Padding coordinates remain fixed while substituting semantic coordinates. The corrected full verification passed for all eleven candidates, both extra packed orders, and forty-coordinate symbolic permutations/quantification.

finding: The first native classifier smoke matched the independent query oracle, then failed its no-resident-growth assertion because it compared a cloned owner against the original construction template. Vec clone had reduced spare capacity from 101,976 to 86,008 estimated bytes while preserving all 719 nodes.
resolution: Measure the actual retained query owner immediately before execution, compare its final footprint against that same owner, and require identical input footprints across trials. The corrected smoke and full same-binary classifier sweep passed.
